description: Defines a template class TokenizedStringList for tokenizing and managing lists of strings, with whitespace removal and separator-based splitting.

classes.name: TokenizedStringList
classes.description: A template class for tokenizing strings into a list based on a separator, with options to remove whitespaces.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Splits the input string into parts based on the separator, optionally removing whitespaces.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the list of tokenized parts.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Returns the first token in the list.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Concatenates all tokens into a single string separated by the separator.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the token list is empty.
